dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-body region displays multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped markings with soft, irregular perimeters that exhibit a diffuse gradient transition from the dark-pigmented dorsal background to the high-intensity off-white interior of the shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a low density of small, concentrated high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily located along the upper dorsal-lateral ridge where they appear as distinct, non-annular spots.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the central flank form a nearly linear, slightly obtuse triangular arrangement oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-intensity vertical white linear feature is visible on the posterior lateral flank, characterized by sharp edges and a lack of the soft gradient seen in natural pigment markings.
other_distinctive_markers: The marking pattern exhibits a reticulated topology where individual circular and semi-circular elements are interconnected by a network of thin, high-contrast filamentary bridges.
